doc_summary: `native_play_level_sound(dimension, at, original_gain, sound, source, gain, cancel)`, a positional level sound about to play (NeoForge `PlayLevelSoundEvent`). `original_gain` and `gain` hold volume and pitch; a mod can change the sound id (`None` drops it), source and gain, or cancel playback. Changed values must pass `native_play_sound`'s checks, or the sound is dropped. Currently only sounds queued with `native_play_sound` are covered. Bundles need "hooks": @API:play_level_sound@.
